conclusions: Latest standard/default selection comes from the current registry/catalog, including changed default IDs and reused run IDs with new public SHA.

Exact published descriptors bind target, law, source/public hashes, dates, configuration, cohort, draw shape and weights. Old or changed index/catalog bytes cannot supply another forecast revision with borrowed metrics.
Refreshed exact reference catalogs attach without per-edition renderer edits; absent, stale or malformed optional references preserve the verified forecast with explicit availability/error state.

Guide active-controller, disposed and abort guards prevent late requests from replacing newer choices. Background refresh follows the selected stable model ID or current default and clears stale references when forecast SHA changes.
Runtime date allowlists are replaced by publication descriptors. Backward-compatible direct matcher calls retain their original exact pins.
Site publication is the descriptor trust root; actual source/scientific qualification remains an upstream reviewed release decision, separate from this runtime matching review.
